record.paper_title: Several Open Problems in Operator Theory
record.original_question: Fix a real number a in [0, 2), and let E_a be the class of all two-dimensional Banach spaces E whose characteristic of convexity epsilon_0(E) equals a. For a Banach space X, the modulus of convexity is delta_X(epsilon) = inf {1 - ||(x + y)/2|| : ||x|| <= 1, ||y|| <= 1, ||x - y|| >= epsilon}, and epsilon_0(X) = sup {epsilon : delta_X(epsilon) = 0}. Given epsilon in [a, 2), what is the supremum of delta_E(epsilon) over all E in E_a?

artifact.category_tag: Modulus of convexity in Banach spaces
artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a real Banach space $X$, define the modulus of convexity
$$\delta_X(\varepsilon) = \inf\bigl\{\, 1 - \tfrac{1}{2}\|x+y\| \;:\; \|x\|\le 1,\ \|y\|\le 1,\ \|x-y\|\ge \varepsilon \,\bigr\}, \qquad \varepsilon\in[0,2],$$
and the characteristic of convexity
$$\varepsilon_0(X) = \sup\{\varepsilon\in[0,2] : \delta_X(\varepsilon) = 0\}.$$
Fix $a \in [0,2)$ and let $\mathcal{E}_a$ denote the class of all two-dimensional real Banach spaces $E$ with $\varepsilon_0(E) = a$. For each $\varepsilon \in [a,2)$, determine
$$\Delta_a(\varepsilon) \;=\; \sup_{E \in \mathcal{E}_a} \delta_E(\varepsilon),$$
and (if attained) identify the two-dimensional Banach spaces $E \in \mathcal{E}_a$ achieving this supremum.
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search did not return a specific reference resolving the extremal value of $\delta_E(\varepsilon)$ over two-dimensional Banach spaces with prescribed characteristic of convexity $\varepsilon_0(E)=a$. While there is extensive literature on bounds, exact values, and comparisons between moduli of convexity in Banach spaces, no source was found that explicitly computes this supremum across the class $\mathcal{E}_a$ for general $a\in[0,2)$. The status is therefore reported as unknown.

status_evidence.title: Modulus of convexity in Banach spaces - ScienceDirect
status_evidence.snippet: Studies the modulus of convexity and related quantitative invariants in Banach spaces.
status_evidence.claim: General background on moduli of convexity, but no explicit solution to the extremal problem for two-dimensional spaces with fixed characteristic of convexity.

status_evidence.title: On Moduli of Convexity in Banach Spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses properties and estimates of moduli of convexity.
status_evidence.claim: Does not appear to determine the supremum of $\delta_E(\varepsilon)$ over two-dimensional spaces with $\varepsilon_0(E)=a$.
